Inkscape Stable

PPA description

The Inkscape Stable PPA is intended to provide the current supported release of Inkscape.

Adding this PPA to your system

You can update your system with unsupported packages from this untrusted PPA by adding ppa:inkscape.dev/stable to your system's Software Sources. (Read about installing) 

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:inkscape.dev/stable
sudo apt update
Technical details about this PPA

This PPA can be added to your system manually by copying the lines below and adding them to your system's software sources.

Display sources.list entries for: 
deb https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/inkscape.dev/stable/ubuntu YOUR_UBUNTU_VERSION_HERE main 
deb-src https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/inkscape.dev/stable/ubuntu YOUR_UBUNTU_VERSION_HERE main
